prompt:
I'm going to travel from May 25 to June 29.
First, I'm going to Halle (Saale), Germany.

During my travel I want to visit Italy (Florence, Rom, Pisa, Capri, Milan), Switzerland (Lugano), Netherlands (Amesterdam, Maastricht), Spain (Madrid, Barcelona), France (Paris, Lyon), Germany (Berlin, Dresden) and Prague.

From May 25-May 29 I want to stay in Halle (Saale), Dresden, Leipzig and Berlin.

I want to visit Prague for only two days, only from June 14-June 16.

After visiting Milan, I want to go Lugano straight and come back to Milan.

I also don't want to visit Venice.

I want to have three days in Paris.

I want to go to the Netherlands from either Paris or Berlin.

On June 27 I want to go back to Halle.

Help me to plan my travel.
answer:
This route fits your dates and keeps most of the journey moving in one direction, with a flight to Prague for your fixed visit. **I’ve assumed you mean May 25–June 29, 2027**, since you haven’t specified a year.

**Route:** Halle → Dresden → Leipzig → Berlin → Amsterdam → Maastricht → Paris → Lyon → Barcelona → Madrid → Prague → Rome → Capri → Florence/Pisa → Milan → Lugano → Milan → Halle.

| Dates | Stay / visit | Suggested plan and transport |
|---|---|---|
| **May 25** | Halle (Saale) | Arrive and settle in. Stay overnight in Halle. |
| **May 26** | Dresden | Train to Dresden; explore the old town and riverfront. |
| **May 27** | Leipzig | Train to Leipzig; explore the centre and stay overnight. |
| **May 28–29** | Berlin | Train to Berlin; spend two days sightseeing. |
| **May 30–31** | Amsterdam | Travel by train from Berlin on May 30. Explore Amsterdam on arrival and the following day. |
| **June 1** | Maastricht | Train from Amsterdam; afternoon and overnight in Maastricht. |
| **June 2** | Travel to Paris | Train via Belgium. Arrive in Paris and stay four nights. |
| **June 3–5** | **Paris** | Three full sightseeing days: one for the Louvre and central Paris, one for the Eiffel Tower and Seine, and one for Montmartre and other favourites. |
| **June 6** | Lyon | Fast train to Lyon; explore Vieux Lyon and enjoy an evening meal. |
| **June 7–9** | Barcelona | Travel June 7; use June 8–9 for sightseeing. Check direct train availability, otherwise connect. |
| **June 10–13** | Madrid | High-speed train from Barcelona. Explore Madrid, with an optional day trip to Toledo or Segovia. |
| **June 14–15** | **Prague** | Fly from Madrid on June 14, preferably early. Stay two nights and explore the old town, Charles Bridge and Prague Castle. |
| **June 16–18** | Rome | Fly to Rome on June 16. Spend June 17–18 on the main sights; reserve the Colosseum and Vatican Museums ahead. |
| **June 19–20** | Capri | Train from Rome to Naples, then ferry to Capri. Stay two nights for Capri town, Anacapri and a boat trip if conditions allow. |
| **June 21–23** | Florence, with Pisa | Ferry back to Naples, then train to Florence on June 21. Explore Florence June 22 and visit Pisa as a day trip June 23. |
| **June 24** | Milan | Train to Milan; explore the Duomo area and city centre. |
| **June 25** | **Lugano → Milan** | Go directly from Milan to Lugano by train, spend the day there, then return directly to Milan that evening. |
| **June 26** | Milan | Another day in Milan and a buffer before your return journey. |
| **June 27** | **Return to Halle** | Allow the day for travel. Compare an all-day rail journey with flying to Berlin or Leipzig/Halle and continuing by train. |
| **June 28–29** | Halle | Rest, local sightseeing and your onward departure. |

Your Prague dates span **two nights, June 14 and 15**, with departure on June 16. Because June 14 includes your flight, this gives you roughly a day and a half of sightseeing; choose an early arrival to maximise the visit.

The first five days are the busiest part. To reduce packing, you could keep Halle as your base on May 25–27, visit Dresden and Leipzig as day trips, and move to Berlin on May 28.

For booking, prioritise **Madrid–Prague on June 14, Prague–Rome on June 16, and Milan–Halle on June 27**. These determine the rest of the route. Transport suggestions here are routing options, not verified timetables.

This plan includes every destination you listed, excludes Venice, gives Paris three full days, enters the Netherlands from Berlin, and preserves your Milan–Lugano–Milan sequence.
